about.sub: We are not here to build walls between ideas.
about.statement: At Chizeon Technologies, we believe technology reaches its highest purpose when it makes life better for people — not just a privileged few.
about.body1: We are a technology company creating digital products, infrastructure and intelligent services for the real needs of everyday living. From financial access to verification, automation and future-facing services, our ambition is to turn complex challenges into experiences that feel simple, useful and human.
about.body2: Our mission is bigger than a single product or market. We want to help shape a future where world-class technology is created, adopted and scaled from Nigeria and across Africa — with the quality, ambition and relevance to serve the world.

ventures.name: Rezovex
ventures.sub: Connecting African capital to global financial opportunities
ventures.summary: Rezovex is a unified financial platform that bridges fragmented financial systems, enabling individuals and businesses to move, convert, manage, and deploy capital across currencies, markets, and asset classes through one seamless experience.

paragraphs: Rezovex simplifies the journey from local liquidity to global opportunity by bringing cross-border payments, multi-currency financial services, digital assets, and global investment access into one intelligent ecosystem.
Our mission is to eliminate the friction, fragmentation, and inefficiencies that prevent capital from moving freely and productively across borders.

Rezovex is building the infrastructure for a world where money is not constrained by geography, financial access is not limited by borders, and capital can work smarter, move faster, and reach further.
closing: One platform. Multiple markets. Limitless financial possibilities.
Rezovex — Making money globally mobile and financially productive.

problem.body: Friction, fragmentation and inefficiency stand between local liquidity and global opportunity.

approach.body: A single, seamless experience from local liquidity to global opportunity.

ventures.name: PropVerify
ventures.tagline: Know the land and the paperwork before you commit.
ventures.summary: A property verification concept designed to help people make more informed real-estate decisions with greater confidence and clarity.

problem.lead: Buying land or property often means piecing together documents, claims and site details from many sources, which makes it hard to know what to trust.
problem.body: One verification file per property with a clear status for every check.

approach.lead: A guided process where documents are submitted, reviewed and organised into a verification report, so a buyer can see what has been checked and what is still open.
approach.body: Verification reports are informational and are not legal advice.

features.title: Document checks
features.description: Submit titles, survey plans and receipts for structured review.

features.title: Ownership history review
features.description: Look at how a property has changed hands, where records exist.

features.title: Site and boundary mapping
features.description: Mark plot boundaries and request a site visit.

features.title: Verification report
features.description: Receive a report that lists each check and its status.

features.title: Seller and agent profiles
features.description: See who you are dealing with and what has been confirmed.

features.title: Progress updates
features.description: Get notified as each step of a case moves forward.

journey.title: Submit details
journey.description: Enter the property address, plot details and parties.

journey.title: Upload documents
journey.description: Add titles, survey plans and receipts to the secure vault.

journey.title: Review and site check
journey.description: Documents are reviewed and a site check can be requested.

journey.title: Get the report
journey.description: Receive a report listing each check and its result.

journey.title: Decide with clarity
journey.description: Use the findings to decide your next step.

ventures.note: PropVerify is in development. Details may change before launch. Verification reports are informational and are not legal advice.

seo.title: PropVerify | Chizeon Technologies Ltd
seo.description: A property verification concept designed to help people make more informed real-estate decisions with greater confidence and clarity.

ventures.name: Mobility Platform
ventures.tagline: A ride that finds you, with a driver who is already on the way.
ventures.summary: Exploring smarter ways to connect people with movement, services and the places they need to reach.

problem.lead: Finding a safe, reliable ride at short notice can mean long waits, unclear prices and little information about who is coming.
problem.body: Upfront fares, live tracking and clear driver details.

approach.lead: A rider app and a driver app joined by real-time matching, so a request is answered by the nearest suitable driver and both sides can follow the trip.
approach.body: Safety and clarity come before speed.

features.title: Request a ride
features.description: Set pick-up and destination and see the fare estimate first.

features.title: Driver matching
features.description: Match requests with nearby available drivers.

features.title: Live trip tracking
features.description: Follow the car on a map from pick-up to drop-off.

features.title: Safety tools
features.description: Driver details and trip sharing to keep people informed.

features.title: Flexible payment
features.description: Support for the payment methods riders and drivers prefer.

features.title: Driver earnings view
features.description: A simple view of trips and earnings for drivers.

journey.title: Request
journey.description: Choose a destination and see the estimated fare.

journey.title: Match
journey.description: The nearest suitable driver accepts the trip.

journey.title: Pick-up
journey.description: Track the car as it arrives and confirm the driver.

journey.title: Ride
journey.description: Follow the route and share the trip if you want.

journey.title: Pay and rate
journey.description: Pay and leave feedback for the driver.

ventures.note: The Mobility Platform is at concept stage and is not a live service. The features described show the intended direction and may change.

ventures.name: Mobile Fuel Delivery
ventures.tagline: Fuel that comes to you, wherever the car is parked.
ventures.summary: An emerging idea focused on making access to emergency fuel assistance more convenient through a technology-enabled service.

problem.lead: Queuing at stations costs time, and fleets and busy drivers lose hours each week to refuelling stops.
problem.body: Order fuel to a location, on a schedule or on demand.

approach.lead: A customer app and a dispatch system that sends a tanker to the vehicle, with the order, delivery and receipt recorded in one place.
approach.body: Safe handling and licensed operators are central to the concept.

features.title: Order to your location
features.description: Share where the vehicle is and choose the fuel and amount.

features.title: Scheduled refills
features.description: Set regular deliveries so vehicles are ready when needed.

features.title: Live delivery tracking
features.description: Follow the tanker as it heads to the vehicle.

features.title: Fleet accounts
features.description: Manage many vehicles and drivers under one account.

features.title: Safety first
features.description: Handling procedures and licensed operators come first.

features.title: Digital receipts
features.description: Every delivery recorded with quantity and cost.

journey.title: Share location
journey.description: Pin where the vehicle is or add a saved address.

journey.title: Choose fuel
journey.description: Pick the fuel type and amount, then confirm the price.

journey.title: Dispatch
journey.description: A nearby tanker is assigned and starts to move.

journey.title: Fuel up
journey.description: The vehicle is fuelled on site and measured.

journey.title: Get the receipt
journey.description: A digital receipt is added to your account.

ventures.note: Mobile Fuel Delivery is at concept stage and is not a live service. Delivery would depend on the required licences and safety approvals.

seo.title: Mobile Fuel Delivery | Chizeon Technologies Ltd
seo.description: An emerging idea focused on making access to emergency fuel assistance more convenient through a technology-enabled service.
